info.title: Geograph API
info.description: The Geograph Application Programming Interface (API) allows third-party developers to access and build applications using data sourced from Geograph in an efficient, structured manner.

get.description:
The most complex API providing a direct JSON wrapper around SphinxQL Queries. To utilize this API effectively, it is highly recommended to understand searching mechanics in Sphinx (in particular the SPH_MATCH_EXTENDED format). Note can do both general queries for image rows, but can also do aggregation queries using SphinxQL 'GROUP BY', including "GROUP n", and grouping by MVA's.

**Fields vs. Attributes Note:**
Sphinx treats search parameters in two distinct ways:
* **Fields:** Used for full-text string searching (e.g., matching text query words inside `match`).
* **Attributes:** Used for filtering (`where`), sorting (`order`), grouping (`group`), and retrieval (`select`).
Often data is stored as an attribute and indexed as a field by the same name. In other cases, a property is optimized as an attribute for sorting/filtering but has a completely different field representation for human keyword searches. The programmatic `describe=1` JSON endpoint provides a raw reference list of these field and attribute names, while the HTML reference page explains what they actually contain.

**FAQ - Fetching the Actual Image URL:**
To build the complete image URL, you must include both the `id` and `hash` fields inside your `select` parameter statement. These values can then be parsed on the client side using the `getGeographUrl(id, hash, size)` helper utility found in our [Geograph API JavaScript Library](https://www.geograph.org.uk/js/geograph-api-libs.js).

**Schema & Attributes Reference:**
You can find the full list of fields and attributes dynamically via:
* Programmatic JSON format: https://api.geograph.org.uk/api-facetql.php?describe=1
* Human-readable HTML page: https://www.geograph.org.uk/stuff/describe.php?index=sample8 (Note: The active production index perfectly matches this original sample8 schema layout!)

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your unique application credential authentication token key. For Client-side requests use your domain name rather than private key.

parameters.name: match
parameters.description: The full-text query expression formatted in Sphinx SPH_MATCH_EXTENDED standard syntax. Note: on Geograph we have a custom query syntax, to map a 'user-entered' query to formal SPH_MATCH_EXTENDED syntax, we provide the getTextQuery reference implementation at https://www.geograph.org.uk/js/geograph-api-libs.js

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Specifies a client-side wrapper callback function identifier name to support JSONP workflows. DEPRECATED. We now support CORS requests.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: General SQL-style WHERE expression clause used to filter on **attributes** (e.g., 'user_id = 123').

parameters.name: geo
parameters.description: Performs a geographically centered radius search matching the format: lat,long,radius(m) (e.g., '56.333,-4.2342,200').

parameters.name: bounds
parameters.description: Executes a geographical bounding box search mapping directly from standard Google Maps API map.getBounds().toString() structures.

parameters.name: olbounds
parameters.description: Executes a geographical bounding box search conforming to OpenLayers notation, or bounds.toBBoxString() in Leaflet.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Configures sorting priority rule criteria when handling grouped results pipelines (e.g., 'WEIGHT() DESC, id DESC'). Note Geo-Queries use 'geodist ASC, id ASC' by default.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Identifies the specific search index attribute name to target for result categorization and grouping operations.

parameters.name: within
parameters.description: Specifies inline sorting ordering conditions applied explicitly within individual localized groups.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Determines the total count threshold ceiling of documents returned.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Specifies paging offset indices. Max matches constraint applies: the combined sum of limit + offset must remain below 1000.

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: Explicit declaration of desired field attributes to return in the row layout array. Set to '*' to fetch all available parameters. Remember to explicitly request 'id' and 'hash' if you intend to resolve complete image URLs with the getGeographUrl helper from geograph-api-libs.js.

parameters.name: describe
parameters.description: Set to 1 to programmatically return the raw schema definition mappings containing available full-text query fields and selectable output response attributes. Note: This output only provides raw reference names; consult the human-readable HTML documentation page to understand exactly what each field indexes or what each attribute contains.

200.description: Successful retrieval of filtered documents accompanied by query execution metadata.

rows.description: Contains matched item records. The schema fields present within each object vary based on the fields requested via the 'select' query parameter.

meta.description: Search execution engine diagnostics, processing metrics, and keyword analytics details.

total.description: total ACCESSSIBLE records, subject to max_matches. Use this total for pagination

total_found.description: total matching records. useful to show a total to users

additionalProperties.description: Dynamic properties reporting keyword, hit count, and document search analysis performance indicators.

get.description: Good For: Screensavers, demos, source of inspiring images. Pros: Very simple API, provides direct access to high-resolution stamped images (so easy to reuse). Has a range of filtering options. Cons: Only offers pre-curated selections.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The output format of the feed.

200.description: Successful feed response matching the requested high-resolution wallpaper format curation.

get.description: Good For: Getting information for a known image URL. Pros: Very simple interface, multiple formats. Cons: No query capabilities, one specific purpose.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL of the Geograph photo page to look up (e.g., http://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/123).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The response format.

200.description: The oEmbed response containing the photo representation metadata structure.

get.description: Accesses the Images database, allowing a wide variety of output formats and filtering options. Most searches via this system can only access the first 1,000 images matching the query. format=JSON highly recommended for programmatic access unless require a specific format.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your unique application credential authentication token key.

parameters.name: i
parameters.description: Runs a predefined search ID.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Return a specific page of results.

parameters.name: u
parameters.description: Limit results to a particular user ID.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text or location search string (e.g., 'bridge near TQ7054' or 'lat,long').

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Returns matching images within a specified distance of a location (grid reference, postcode, or decimal lat/long).

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Returns only images matching this text search string.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: Limit results to within this distance in km (used with q or location).

parameters.name: perpage
parameters.description: Number of results per page.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: If present (set to 1), includes the thumbnail of the image in the description as HTML (not applicable to KML).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The output format of the feed.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wraps the output in a function call. Only works with format=JSON. DEPRECATED.

parameters.name: simple
parameters.description: If present (set to 1) and format=KML, includes styling to hide the picture label unless hovering.

200.description: Successful feed response matching requested format.

get.description:
A lightweight companion utility designed explicitly to fetch the raw text description and any associated shared reusable text snippets for a single photograph by its ID.

**CRITICAL USAGE NOTE:** This endpoint is a specialized polyfill for the FacetQL API (where description text is an unselectable search field). It is **NOT** intended for bulk harvesting, scraping, or high-volume sequential lookups. If you require descriptions for multiple images at once, utilize `/syndicator.php` or the bulk CSV engine instead.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your unique application credential authentication token key.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique numeric ID of the Geograph photograph.

200.description: The raw comment and cross-referenced shared description snippets payload mapping for the requested photo ID.

comment.description: The primary description text block for the image, which may contain bracketed references matching entries in the snippets array.
comment.example: This is the top lake [1] of Ffestiniog Pumped Storage Scheme. The bottom lake and the power station [2] can be seen at the bottom of the mountain. Taken from the south ridge leading up Moelwyn Mawr [4].

snippets.description: An array of reusable shared description snippet objects referenced by the primary comment text block.

comment.description: The contextual text fragment of the shared snippet.
comment.example: The top reservoir of Ffestiniog Pumped Storage Scheme, which is held in place by Stwlan Dam, a highly visible local landmark (when it's not foggy).

reference_index.description: The identifier matching the bracketed index in the parent comment text.

get.description: Returns details about a particular photograph.

parameters.name: photo_id
parameters.description: The unique numeric ID of the photo.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: Your unique API Key (or public domain name if using client-side JSONP requests).

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: The alternative output configuration parameter.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: JSONP callback function name (applicable if output=json). DEPRECATED.

200.description: Photo information details map metadata layer.

get.description: Returns information about a specific 4-figure grid square reference.

parameters.name: gridref
parameters.description: Four-figure OS Grid Reference (e.g., SD1234).

200.description: Details about the given grid square.

get.description: Returns surrounding images within a specified distance. Note: using syndicator.php is recommended instead of this endpoint.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: Distance radius threshold in km (should be 10km or below).

parameters.name: lat_long
parameters.description: Comma-separated latitude and longitude decimal values (e.g., 50.64163,-1.94978).

get.description: Suited for bulk synchronization tasks. Note: These CSV exports only return up to 1,000 records without prior layout arrangement. We now provide bulk exports seperately at https://data.geograph.org.uk/

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your unique application credential authentication token key.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Returns all images submitted or modified on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: last
parameters.description: Returns records modified within a relative backframe delta window (e.g., '7 day', '6 hour').

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Returns the latest specified number of records in descending date order.

parameters.name: ri
parameters.description: Limits results to a specific National Grid system.

parameters.name: i
parameters.description: Runs a predefined search query ID. Note: Can't be combined with 'since', 'last', 'limit', or 'ri'.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Overrides page size layout constraints for predefined query configurations (use -1 for biggest max default, usually 1000).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Returns a specific page index of paginated records context.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: Explicit text charset setting. Fallback sets standard latin1 defaults.

parameters.name: taken
parameters.description: Includes taken date attributes when enabled.

parameters.name: en
parameters.description: Adds Eastings, Northings, and Precision column flags. Cannot be used alongside ll or tags.

parameters.name: coords
parameters.description: Enforces calculation details payload context properties mapping resolution overrides for 4-figure grid entries when paired with en=1.

parameters.name: ll
parameters.description: Adds WGS84 Latitude and Longitude columns.

parameters.name: thumb
parameters.description: Appends full 120x120 pixel thumbnail URI location paths.

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: Includes standard raw text photo description body arrays.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: Appends camera view field direction angle maps.

parameters.name: ppos
parameters.description: Includes Eastings, Northings, and Precision vectors explicitly tracking camera source parameters. Cannot be combined with ll or tags parameters.

parameters.name: submitted
parameters.description: Includes file upload timeline metadata entries.

parameters.name: hits
parameters.description: Includes tracking interaction count metrics views indexes.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Includes moderation verification workflow values data profiles.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Includes user profile attribution indexing values markers.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: Includes point structure distribution score attributes lists.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Appends question mark delimited taxonomy tag lists. Cannot be combined with en or ppos parameters.

200.description: A CSV file payload payload data stream configuration.

ApiKeyAuth.description: The unique application credential token key assigned string.

geograph-api-libs.description: Official client-side JavaScript helper library containing URL generation utilities like getGeographUrl() and custom query format standard conversions like getTextQuery().
